# `notice`

Helper: `notice(text, tone, { title, actions, items, itemsTitle })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Notice` (shared) · status: shared (next to the kit)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaNotice` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Icon, optional bold title, text, optional bullet list (with a bold list title), optional buttons.

## Variants

- Tone: info, warning, danger, success
- With `items`, with `actions`

## States

- Static. A danger notice is announced as an alert in the kit (role alert)

## Tokens

info/warning/danger/success with -soft and -line, radius-tile

## Do

- Keep the old text verbatim
- One notice per message

## Don't

- Do not use danger for a boxed hint that is only information
- Do not put fields inside (use `box`)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Padding 8/12, icon 18. Kit names the tones `info`, `warn`, `error`, `success`; the canvas says `warning` and `danger`.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

tone `info warning danger success`; text verbatim; `title` = bold first line; `items` (+ bold `itemsTitle`, e.g. "Điểm cần nhớ") = bullet list; `actions: [btn]` for notices with buttons. The coverage check reads title, text, bullets and button labels in order as one old notice
